Done

Admin-controlled user accounts

Done

  • Acceptance test: 13/13 security checks pass.

Generate 6 Videos (first version)

Done

Stage 9

Automatic AI Video Director (Claude)

Done
  • “Create My Video Automatically”: Claude reviews the photos, then writes a storyboard in one of six styles.
  • Every on-screen claim is fact-checked against the listing; nothing is invented.
  • Super Admin sets the Claude key, model, limits and monthly budget; cost is tracked per run.
  • Tested with a simulated Claude response (no API key in this environment yet).

Commit 42b1652

Stage 10

Six-video automatic generator

Done
  • Six types: Cinematic Property Tour, Just Listed Reel, Luxury Highlights, Open House Promotion, Short Social Media Reel, Agent-Branded Advertisement.
  • Each has its own opener, pacing, transitions and emphasis; vertical 1080×1920 by default.
  • Address and price overlays, company logo and licensed music on every video.
  • Licensed music library: five original built-in tracks; uploads offered only after an admin verifies commercial use.
  • Expected-usage panel before generating; the optional AI Director planner needs a cost confirmation.
